versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the weekly-report-framework (V2.5), designed for research group managers to generate and export weekly project reports.
- Supports three initialization methods: markdown template, guided dialogue, or Excel template (auto-generated).
- Adds lifecycle with 11 project phases, dual-table structure, 12 field columns, chat message capture, incremental updates, and learning/iteration capability.
- New in V2.5: automatic anomaly detection for inactive group chats and long-unupdated project statuses.
- Multi-lab support with adaptive naming, numbering, and file paths for Mechatronics, Industrial Vision, and Logistics & Automation groups.
